::: {#exm-bootstrap-sample-toy}
#### Bootstrap samples of five glucose values

Take the baseline fasting glucose values
of the first five HERS participants,
and draw two bootstrap samples from them:

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
glucose5 <- hers$glucose[1:5]
glucose5
set.seed(1)
list(
  sample_1 = sample(glucose5, replace = TRUE),
  sample_2 = sample(glucose5, replace = TRUE)
)
```

Each bootstrap sample has five values,
but some original values appear more than once
and others do not appear at all.
:::
